$comment: Journey inventory for the attendee app (M7.x). tools/check-maestro checks this file against the flows in this directory and against docs/plans/mobile.md. Every key is explained in docs/specs/M7.X/maestro.md.

wallet-add.yaml.ciReason: The wallet link opens the system Wallet or a browser outside the app, which Maestro cannot follow deterministically.

calendar-directions.yaml.ciReason: Hands off to the system Calendar and Maps, whose screens differ by OS version and emulator image.

virtual-ticket.yaml.ciReason: Needs an online event, and no dev route or seed creates one (the organizer console does).

near-me.yaml.ciReason: Needs a simulated device location, which the EAS runner does not set.

push-tap-cold-start.yaml.ciReason: Needs a push sent from outside Maestro (xcrun simctl push), which an EAS runner cannot do.

push-tap-foreground.yaml.ciReason: Needs a push sent from outside Maestro (xcrun simctl push), which an EAS runner cannot do.

link-universal.yaml.ciReason: The OS verifies https links only for a store-signed build against the production domains; CI builds are unsigned.

update-required.yaml.ciReason: Needs a server whose minimum app version is above the build's; the shared e2e server is not.

journeys.title: Launch: a fresh install opens on the welcome screen
Sign in by email code (new account, wrong code, right code)
Sign in with Apple
journeys.manual: Completing Sign in with Apple needs the system's Apple ID sheet and a real Apple account, and the app has no test seam for it; the flow proves only that the button shows on iOS and not on Android. The server side is covered by the api-v1 integration tests.
devicePass: Sign in with Apple on a real iPhone with a sandbox Apple ID.

journeys.title: Sign in with Google
journeys.manual: Completing Google sign-in needs a real Google account and the owner's OAuth client ids; the e2e build has none, so the button is absent by design and the flow asserts that. The server side is covered by the api-v1 integration tests.
devicePass: Google sign-in on a real iPhone and an Android phone, once the owner adds the OAuth client ids.
